lines.text: [warm] So — how do you get work done without doing it yourself?
These are jobs you hand the agent once. It does them for you, every morning, every Monday.
[curious] Nothing to fill in — you just press one button.
And the agent asks you what you want done, and how often.
You answer like you would tell a person.
And where you want it — your email, or Slack.
[confident] It writes the whole thing itself, and sets it up.
[excited] Done. There it is, and one switch turns it off.
Want more people on it? Open the settings.
Add Slack channels, or anyone else by email. Save.
Open the task to see exactly what it does, and when it runs next.
Do not want to wait? Run it right now.
And every run before this one is kept, right here.
[warm] Open one — and this is exactly what lands in your email, or in Slack.
The agent's last message is the report you get: what changed with your money, and what to do about it.
Set it once. [smiling] It keeps happening without you.
